name.full: KIBO Privacy OS — Autonomous Multi-Jurisdictional Privacy Office for Microsoft 365 Copilot & Teams

description.short: Governed Privacy Office assistant for US, Canada, and EU compliance.
description.full: Enterprise-governed Privacy Office integration for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Teams. Provides organization-aware privacy guidance, incident reporting, PIA/DPIA/TRA/TIA/LIA/AIIA initiation, vendor DPA/BAA/SCC verification, policy search, JRAE regulatory applicability analysis, and human approval routing with strict Microsoft Entra ID SSO and tenant isolation.
